materials.content:
Watercolor on moderately thick, cream, smooth wove paper with a slightly fuzzy feel
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance:
1958, sold by the Downtown Gallery, New York, to William H. Lane (b. 1914 - d. 1995), Leominster, MA; 1995, by inheritance to his wife, Saundra B. Lane, Lunenburg, MA; 2023, gift of Saundra B. Lane to the MFA. (Accession Date: April 12, 2023) 
(Source: MFA Boston, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: dark figure." Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1916. See cat. no. 228. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication dates this work as 1918, MFA dates it as 1916. (Source: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* from MFA Boston, 2025)

titles.notes: Source of title: Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Portrait – Black

description: A figure with long, black hair stands in the center of the composition wearing a black and white cloak. On either side of the figure are amorphous black shapes that appear to be floating. Swirling black and gray clouds form the background of this work.
title: Portrait – Black
